verdict.rationale: Luma is a video-generation platform with a public API, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only REST endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, a web workspace and Luma Agents, with no mention of an official command-line tool. SDKs are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
